reactor_type: Ultratech Savannah S200 with insulated lid
evidence: Next, using a commercial hot-wall viscous-flow ALD reactor (Ultratech Savannah S200 with insulated lid), films were grown in continuous-flow mode by alternating pulses of Mo(NMe2)4 and H2S using an ultra-high-purity N 2 carrier gas. The Mo(NMe2)4 precursor reservoir was maintained at 60 8C (see the Supporting Information). Deposition was quantified for Mo(NMe2)4 pulse times ranging from 0.1 to 40 s, H 2S pulse times ranging from 0.01 to 1 s, with typical purge times of 30 s.
